about.description: Etherfuse is a regulated multichain tokenization platform for tokenized sovereign debt ("Stablebonds"). Six live stablebonds as of June 2026: CETES (Mexico), USTRY (US), GILTS (UK), EUROB (EU), TESOURO (Brazil), KTB (South Korea - via Shinhan Securities partnership). Each 1:1 backed by underlying government bond. Yield compounds into NAV; instant redemption via SDK. Cross-chain on Solana, Stellar, Base, Polygon, and Monad. Acquired by RedStone ecosystem reach via TokenizeThis 2026 sponsorship.
about.registryInfo: Etherfuse - regulated multichain issuer of tokenized sovereign debt. US domicile; primary-market access restricted to Non-U.S. investors. Operates under Switzerland DLT Act / FINMA. Custody arrangements vary per stablebond: BBVA (CETES), Spiko SICAV (USTRY, EUROB), Archax Ltd (GILTS), B3 SA Brasil Bolsa Balcão (TESOURO), Shinhan Securities (KTB). RedStone provides 24/7 FX-adjusted price oracles.
